messages:
Maya: Quick signal from staging: FP8 path for redwood/v1-small shows a steady drift in token quality after ~800 tokens on multi-chunk documents. Not a throughput anomaly, looks like semantic drift.

Ravi: Can you share a short log/snippet and whether KV hits remain high?

Maya: Pasted excerpt (redacted):
```
[2026-03-20T09:12:09Z] model=redwood/v1-small variant=fp8_perf seq=2048 batch=4 kv_hit=true token_idx=812 quality_flag=ok
[2026-03-20T09:12:10Z] token_idx=813 quality_flag=warning rolling_degradation=0.28 fp8_scale=1.15
[2026-03-20T09:12:11Z] token_idx=814 quality_flag=fail output_confidence=0.12
```
This reproduces locally on our longctx harness. bench-bot also shows cohort uplift.

bench-bot: sampling-summary: fp8_longctx_degradation_cohort +2.9x vs int8 baseline over last 72h. statistical-significance: high.

Terra: We recently enabled dynamic per-layer rescale and an FP8 aggressive quant table for perf lanes. Might be an interaction with KV chunk normalization across reloads.

Lee: Quick thought: FP8 reduces head margin. If per-layer rescale uses moving stats across chunks, you can get an accumulated bias. Have we observed head-specific saturation counters?

Maya: Not yet. I'll add head saturation telemetry. For an immediate mitigation, thinking of a dual-run fallback: keep generation on fp8 by default but if a rolling_degradation metric crosses threshold after token N, switch to an int8-safe variant for the remaining tokens. That should preserve early-cost savings.

Nina: I support a conservative runtime switch. Suggested predicate: token_idx > 800 && rolling_degradation > 0.25 && model_family == 'small' -> route to int8_mild. Also require that switch emits a full token history and a sample dump for offline diffs (tag fp8-longctx-fallback-03-20).

Ravi: Also require a rate limit on automated routing toggles per-request to avoid oscillation (don't flip more than once per request).

Maya: Prototype predicate in pseudocode:
```
if (token_idx > 800 && rolling_deg > 0.25 && variant.startsWith('fp8')) {
  route_to('int8_mild')
  emit_trace('fp8-longctx-fallback-03-20')
}
```

Terra: For canary, propose 3% traffic for 48h with shadow eval on our longctx regression set (N=10k). Metric set: rolling_degradation, token_confidence_delta, semantic-coherence score, and latency delta.

bench-bot: note: shadow-eval harness currently doesn't include multi-chunk prefix-stitch cases at scale. We'll need to augment the corpus.

Lee: Long-term: add a lint to map clip/rescale parameters to typical seq_len distribution per model. If a model has >30% requests >1024, warn when aggressive fp8 params are used. Also build a per-head drift detector that triggers early sampling.

Nina: Ops: make fallback config-only so we can flip without a deploy. Also ensure the change increments an observability tag and doesn't inflate customer billing signals.

ops-bot: Rollout playbook: config canary 3% for 48h. Monitors: rolling_degradation (alert if increased), fallback_rate, token_latency. Post-canary: if fallback reduces regression incidents by >=70% and latencies within 5%, plan wider rollout.

Ravi: Experiment plan: 1) temporarily disable aggressive fp8 quant table for longctx lanes and run 5k shadow samples, 2) increase per-layer rescale smoothing window, 3) deploy runtime predicate as a safety net. Collect diffs vs int8 baseline for semantic drift.

Maya: I'll open the follow-up RFC with the runtime predicate, canary configuration, required telemetry (head saturation counters, rolling_deg histograms), and a checklist for shadow-eval corpus augmentation. Tagging @Terra @Lee for technical review.

Terra: If the disable/increase-smoothing fixes the issue we should adjust the default fp8 profile to be less aggressive for long-context models. Also add a regression test that exercises KV reload boundaries.

Lee: I'll sketch the head-saturation telemetry schema and add a counter to the GPU trace.

Nina: Thanks all. When RFC/PR ready ping infra for canary and I'll support dashboard wiring. :thumbsup:
